finding: The source file has a per-file cap but reads each file to EOF before check_source_tree applies its 10 MB aggregate cap. Thus a malformed or concurrently changed pinned manifest/source tree can exceed the intended aggregate read bound during hashing. V11 will pre-sum strict manifest sizes before hashing, check each live file size before open, and pass the smaller expected-file/remaining-aggregate cap to an incrementally bounded read loop.
